title.full: When you can withdraw CPF savings

summary.text: You can apply before 55 only if a medical condition affects your life expectancy, work ability, or mental capacity.

details.heading: Conditions for early withdrawal
details.body: You may apply earlier if a medical condition reduces your life expectancy, makes you permanently unfit for work, or causes permanent lack of mental capacity.

example_phrasings: Can I withdraw my CPF savings before I turn 55?
Can I take out my CPF early?
When can I withdraw my CPF savings?

sources.page_title: Can I withdraw my CPF savings before I turn 55?

quotes.text: You can apply to withdraw your CPF savings earlier if you have a medical condition that reduces your life expectancy or causes you to be permanently unfit for work or lack mental capacity permanently.
